table inet dstack_dante_leg {
	set dante_udp {
		type inet_service
		flags interval
		elements = { 319-320, 4321, 4440-4486, 5353, 8700-8708,
			     8800-8831, 14336-14591, 29800-31847 }
	}

	set dante_groups {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 224.0.0.0/24, 224.0.1.129-224.0.1.132,
			     239.0.0.0/8 }
	}

	set remote_tcp {
		type inet_service
		elements = { 22, 8092 }
	}

	chain in {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		iifname != "zzleg0.70" accept
		ct state established,related accept
		ct state invalid counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		meta nfproto ipv6 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		ip protocol { icmp, igmp } accept
		udp dport @dante_udp accept
		ip daddr @dante_groups meta l4proto udp accept
		udp sport 5353 udp dport 32768-60999 accept
		udp sport 67 udp dport 68 accept
		tcp dport @remote_tcp accept
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain out {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		oifname != "zzleg0.70" accept
		udp dport 5353 ip daddr 224.0.0.251 limit rate over 50/second burst 200 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		ct state established,related accept
		meta nfproto ipv6 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		ip protocol { icmp, igmp, udp } accept
		tcp dport @remote_tcp accept
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}
}
table inet dstack_dante_leg_notrack {
	chain raw_pre {
		type filter hook prerouting priority raw; policy accept;
		iifname != "zzleg0.70" notrack
	}

	chain raw_out {
		type filter hook output priority raw; policy accept;
		oifname != "zzleg0.70" notrack
	}
}
